youtube.title: Why Swiss Cheese Is Losing Its Holes 🧀 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Swiss cheese has been losing its holes, and scientists figured out why.

Bacteria make the gas, but Swiss researchers (Agroscope) found tiny hay particles in the milk are where the bubbles start. Modern, ultra-clean milking removed the hay, so Swiss cheese got fewer holes.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
